2.7.5.app_readme: Professional backup solution for Blackmagic HyperDeck recorders. Automatically backs up recordings to NAS, Google Drive, SFTP servers, and USB drives.
2.7.5.detailed_readme: HyperDeck Backup Manager automates the process of backing up video recordings from Blackmagic HyperDeck devices to multiple destinations. Requires a license key from Entertainment IT.
2.7.5.changelog: v2.7.5: Added license system, improved Media I/O browsers, comprehensive PDF user guide with installation addendum.
